main.ap.description: entry, init, frame loop (input, ticks, render, ui, present, sleep), pause/speed

src/defs.ap.description: shared .define constants only: sizes, record layouts, regions, palette, keys, tuning

src/state.ap.description: all shared game state (data only) incl. the 100x30 display block

src/map.ap.description: terrain generation, tile get/set, walkability, area checks

src/render.ap.description: viewport: terrain, rides, track, guests, cursor, scrolling

src/ui.ap.description: panel, status bar, messages (ui_msg), help line, quit prompt

src/economy.ap.description: money ops (thousands+units), calendar, upkeep, fees, loan, monthly report

src/input.ap.description: key dispatch, cursor movement, tool selection, pause/speed, quit confirm

src/rides.ap.description: ride/stall catalog, records, operation cycle, queues, income

src/guests.ap.description: spawning, needs, decisions, movement, riding/buying, leaving

src/windows.ap.description: info and finance windows over the panel

src/coaster.ap.description: track designer, circuit validation (WP11); ratings, train animation (WP12)
